messages:
maria.devex: Heads-up — multiple customers reported a spike in 401s + token retries after the SDK regen CI run yesterday. Billing alerted on retry storm.

kai.support: Ack. We have 3 open escalations, two are enterprise tenants on dedicated. They saw request latencies jump then a cascade of 401s. We repro locally.

sam.oncall: Paging logs — I’m seeing thousands of repeated POST /v1/generate with 401 responses, then client retries with exponential backoff but short max backoff -> lots of token validation attempts.

alex.eng-runtime: Any pattern on auth header shape? header name/casing? token format?

kai.support: Yes — older SDKs send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. New generated clients (Go, TS) appear to send `authorization:bearer <token>` (no space after colon) or sometimes `X-Api-Key` moved to cookie. Some servers treat header parsing strictly.

maria.devex: Repro steps I used (quick):
```
# curl repro
curl -v -H "Authorization:Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
It returns 401. If I fix to `-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` works.
```
# python repro (client)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN)
c.generate("hi")  # with regenerated client that has header bug -> 401
```

julia.eng-ml: Why did the regen change header formatting? Was OpenAPI changed?

mark.devex: I dug into the spec diff — PR #412 added a small vendor extension `x-auth-prefix: \"Bearer\"` and the codegen template combined prefix and header without a separating space by mistake. Unit tests didn't catch it because we only asserted header key present, not exact formatting.

ci-bot: CI job `regen-clients` succeeded. No unit tests flagged.

alex.eng-runtime: Ok — that explains the 401s. The retry storm/billing comes from clients retrying on 401s with optimistic retry policy. We need an immediate mitigation: rollback regenerated packages, publish hotfix, and tweak retry policy to not retry on 401.

sam.oncall: Quick mitigation steps I recommend:
1) Revoke problematic release tag and unpublish packages (npm/gomod/pypi) if possible.
2) Patch regen template to insert a single space after colon when composing `Authorization` header.
3) Add unit tests asserting exact header string: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
4) Short term: apply server-side tolerant parsing for `authorization:bearer` until clients patched.

kai.support: For customers: we offered rollback on their dedicated clusters and temporary credentials. Two customers accepted. One asked for patch timeline.

mark.devex: I have a PR ready for the template change + tests. Pushing now. Also adding an integration test in regen pipeline that does an end-to-end header check using a local mock auth server.

julia.eng-ml: We should also check if codegen trimmed spaces for other headers — sending a quick grep across generated clients now.

alex.eng-runtime: Also open a short-term patch to retry logic: do not retry on 401/403 and add jitter + longer backoff to avoid billing spikes. Might be a feature flag.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026. Pager duty page: oncall@redwood.

maria.devex: Nice work. Action items: mark (devex) to merge template hotfix + release patched clients; alex to change default retry policy; sam to coordinate server-side tolerant parsing; kai to follow up with customers and close escalations.

kai.support: Will update customers in #customer-success and post follow-ups here when each tenant is patched. :thumbsup:

mark.devex: Hotfix published for TS and Go clients (1.2.1). Py client was unaffected but republished to be safe. CI regen now has new integration test.

sam.oncall: Monitoring — retry rate and billing anomaly trending down. Will keep page open for 24h.

maria.devex: Closing loop — please add changelog note: "regen template bug fixed: Authorization header formatting" and link to INC-2026.

kai.support: Closing escalations as customers confirm resolution. Thanks everyone. :heart:
